assays.assay_description: Mice injected i.p. and placed individually in an observation cage with fresh bedding; 10 min after injection, overhead camera recorded behaviour for 10 min; videotapes scored for head twitches by blind observer. Covers acute dose-effect curves (DOI, 2C-T-7, DPT, DIPT), tolerance protocols (daily x5, every other day x5, weekly x4), and DOI-induced tolerance surmountability / cross-tolerance tests on day 4.

application_type.evidence: Doses were then calculated and prepared for intraperitoneal injection.

time_to_assay.evidence: Ten minutes after this injection, an overhead camera was activated and behavior was recorded for 10 minutes.

sample_size.evidence: Mice were randomly assigned to experimental groups ( n = 5 or 6 per group)

outcomes.summary: All four compounds elicited biphasic dose-dependent HTR vs saline (max ~18 for DOI 1 mg/kg, ~16 for 2C-T-7 1 mg/kg, ~15 for DPT 3 mg/kg, <8 for DIPT 10 mg/kg). Daily (and every-other-day) DOI and daily 2C-T-7 produced progressive tolerance, whereas DPT, DIPT and weekly DOI did not. DOI tolerance was insurmountable with higher DOI doses and conferred insurmountable cross-tolerance to 2C-T-7 and DPT.
outcomes.statistics: Dose-effect (Kruskal-Wallis, Dunn's): DOI 0.3 Q=4.033, 1.0 Q=4.427, 3.0 Q=3.864; 2C-T-7 1.0 Q=4.230; DPT 3.0 Q=4.244, 10.0 Q=3.108; DIPT 10.0 Q=3.545 (all P<0.05). Tolerance (RM ANOVA, Tukey): DOI days 2-5 vs day 1 Q=6.786, 11.875, 16.116, 21.205; 2C-T-7 days 2-5 vs day 1 Q=12.623, 16.831, 21.974, 22.909; DOI every other day injections 3-5 vs first Q=5.787, 9.042, 13.201 (P<0.05). Surmountability: saline-pretreated DOI 0.3 Q=3.996, 1.0 Q=5.307, 3.0 Q=4.101; between-group 0.3 Q=4.437, 1.0 Q=5.424, 3.0 Q=4.411. Cross-tolerance: 2C-T-7 1.0 Q=5.628; DPT 3.0 Q=4.491 (P<0.05).
outcomes.evidence: Tolerance developed to HTR elicited by daily DOI or 2C-T-7, but not to HTR elicited by DPT or DIPT. DOI-elicited tolerance was not surmountable with dose, and a similar insurmountable cross-tolerance was evident when DOI-tolerant mice were tested with various doses of 2C-T-7 or DPT.

judge_notes: All candidates identified a single HTR assay; dose-effect, tolerance, surmountability and cross-tolerance experiments collapsed into one assay per rubric.
B1 set to 1 measure (head twitch count only), following qwen/gemma majority; deepseek's counting of saline controls as a second measure is incorrect.
D3 set to 2-7 (max 5 recording days per animal); gemma's 8-14 conflated study span (day 9) with number of recording days.
DOI is not in the provided markdown masthead; candidates disagreed (two null, one apparently fabricated), so doi = null.
Age set to not_reported: paper gives only body weight (20-25 g), no age.
DOI schedule set to 'chronic' because every-other-day (9 days) and weekly (22 days) regimens exceed 7 days of dosing; other compounds dosed daily x5 = repeated.
Outcome direction 'increase' reflects significant HTR induction vs saline; tolerance-related decreases captured via time_dependent = yes and summary.
